According to NCERT principles for Politics of Planned Development (Politics of Planned Development):

At its Avadi session in 1955, the Indian National Congress resolved that planning must aim to establish a 'socialistic pattern of society'. This principle became the governing philosophy of the Second Five-Year Plan (1956-1961), authored by P.C.
